lines.prompt: Update the name of signal n440 to renamed_wire throughout the netlist. Ensure the design functionality does not change.

golden.reference: Renamed signal n440 to renamed_wire throughout the netlist (4 references updated); functionality unchanged.
golden.notes: Transform must be a pure bijective rename: every occurrence of n440 replaced by renamed_wire, netlist otherwise identical/equivalent. Teams 2, 3, 7 all independently report 4 references updated (objective sanity number for the ORIGINAL netlist); Team4 omits the count but still scored full, so the count is optional. Grading: success claim + functionality-preserved claim; verify on output netlist that n440 is gone and renamed_wire drives/loads the same gates.
